KIND:       SendActivity
SCHEMA:     bot (vendor/skills-for-copilot-studio @ 9c42d3a)

DESCRIPTION:
    Sends a message to the user: plain text, a template, message variations,
    speech, quick replies or card attachments. Under generative orchestration
    prefer topic outputs for final results, so the orchestrator writes the
    answer.

    YAML: `kind: SendActivity`
    See: docs/05-nodes.md#sendactivity

FIELDS:
  kind	<string> -required-
    Must be "SendActivity".

  activity	<ActivityTemplateBase> -required-
    The message: a plain string, a `{...}` template, or an object with text
    (variations), speak, quickReplies and attachments. Most channels collapse
    plain newlines, so use `<br />` for breaks; quote values that start with `{`
    or contain `: `.
    one of 3 kinds: cs-explain SendActivity.activity

  conversationOutcome	<ConversationOutcome>
    Marks the conversation's outcome (ResolvedConfirmed, ResolvedImplied or
    Escalated) for analytics when this node runs. (inferred)
    enum: ResolvedConfirmed, ResolvedImplied, Escalated

  disabled	<boolean>
    The node is skipped at runtime. (inferred)
    default: false

  displayName	<string>
    The label shown on the node in the authoring canvas.

  id	<string> -required-
    Unique within the topic. Convention: `<nodeType>_<6-8 random
    alphanumerics>`, e.g. `sendMessage_k3Jd9a`. Duplicate IDs (from copy-pasted
    nodes or leftover `_REPLACE` placeholders) fail on push.
